text: Vietjet, Haite Group sign aviation cooperation deal

KUNMING - Vietjet and China's Haite Group have signed a memorandum of understanding to cooperate on aircraft maintenance, aviation technology and technical workforce training, as the airline seeks to expand its aviation service capabilities in Việt Nam and the region.

The agreement was signed on Saturday at the Việt Nam-Southwest China Development Strategy Connectivity Forum in Kunming, in the presence of Vietnamese Standing Deputy Prime Minister Phạm Gia Túc and senior officials from both countries.
General Secretary of the Communist Party of Việt Nam and President Tô Lâm attended and addressed the forum during his visit to China for APEC Economic Leaders' Week and bilateral engagements.
Under the agreement, the two sides will explore cooperation in aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), component and avionics maintenance, aircraft modification and technical training.

They will also consider developing aviation industrial services and aircraft lifecycle management, as well as maintenance and training capabilities in Việt Nam, including at Long Thành International Airport, to serve Vietjet and other regional airlines.

"The sustainable development of the aviation industry requires not only fleet and network expansion but also strong technical capabilities, technology and a highly skilled workforce," said Nguyễn Thanh Sơn, Vietjet's chief executive officer.

The partnership would allow both companies to combine their strengths in MRO, training and aviation industrial services, creating long-term value for the aviation sector in Việt Nam and the region, he said.
Founded in 1991, Haite Group operates in aviation technology, high-tech equipment and integrated circuits.
Its aviation operations cover aircraft and engine maintenance, equipment manufacturing, training and aviation finance.
The company is recognised as a national enterprise technology centre in China and supports the country's aero-engine development.

The partnership forms part of Vietjet's efforts to expand international cooperation and strengthen its technical and aviation service capabilities, contributing to the long-term development of the aviation sector in Việt Nam and Southeast Asia. - VNS
